scope_statement: Count only Claude-marked single-parent squash 9783f346795be919bffda8a6475ae716a9e3580c, whose first-parent diff adds src/ha_mcp/settings_ui.py and registers unauthenticated mcp.custom_route('/', ...) plus /api/settings/tools and /api/settings/restart under is_addon so Home Assistant ingress can serve Open Web UI. Do not count secret-prefix mounts. Do not treat later policy/features/backup routes as a second origin; they reuse the same unauthenticated root-mount pattern and are closed by the same 9f5b085a ingress guard. Count git tag v7.5.0 / PyPI ha-mcp 7.5.0 as the vulnerable artifact whose exact custom_route('/') lines still blame 9783f346. Count git tag v7.7.0 / PyPI 7.7.0 as the first non-prerelease reversal. Global first_patched 7.10.0 also contains that reversal after the settings_ui package split; it is not required because 7.7.0 already wraps every advisory-named root route.
ai_marker_evidence: 9783f346 is a single-parent squash of PR #960. Subject feat: web-based settings UI for per-tool enable/disable/pin (#960). The squash body carries Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com> on members and a final Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.6 trailer on the squash itself. First-parent 8ba80aee has no src/ha_mcp/settings_ui.py. The is_addon block registers mcp.custom_route('/', ...) and /api/settings/tools plus /api/settings/restart with no secret and no ingress IP guard.

fixed_release_evidence.note: Repo GHSA range is <= 7.6.0. Global GHSA first_patched is 7.10.0. Independent git and wheels show 7.7.0 already wraps tools, features, backups, restart, and policy root routes in _ingress_only. 7.10.0 still has that same 9f5b085a guard after the package split.

full_surface_vulnerable_release.note: v7.6.0 is the last unguarded non-prerelease with the full advisory-named route list. Exact custom_route('/') lines blame later Claude-marked squash 6c3c0ac4 (stdio UI rewrite), not 9783f346. Origin containment therefore uses v7.5.0, where those lines still blame 9783f346. 6c3c0ac4 is not counted as a second origin.

uniqueness.note: Distinct first-party GHSA and sink from OAuth ha_url SSRF, www/yaml_backups local read, and OAuth consent XSS. Shared repository is not duplication.
